_comment: A RECEIVE peer (ADR-012 §1.4): a system with no PBS of its own — another TAPPaaS configured with an external PBS pointing at us, or a device (Synology, TrueNAS, laptop) — that PUSHES its backups into receive/<name> on our datastore. It authenticates as <name>@pbs with the DatastoreBackup role on that namespace only (write, no delete); we own the retention. Its client-side encryption is its own business — we hold ciphertext. Created by: backup-manager peer add receive <name>.
name: synology
